bifrost: No call framework. Adjacent: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs, springboard/audiod/src/
summary: BifrOSt has no VoIP, telephony or call-UI code. Only notifications and audio exist as building blocks; a calling feature would need its own API. The incoming call prompt is a pure model in springboard/ui/src/call.rs; the shell does not draw it yet.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no call provider registration

Pure prompt model: a ringing incoming call gets a banner or, while the device is locked, a full-screen prompt with answer and decline actions. Host unit tests (3 new). Built on parity/team-a-03; not yet verified on Midget. The shell does not draw the prompt yet.
